title: Proactive, reactive and retroactive in one conversation
description: Nobody says 'not sure' for the first question; a tentative claim is made in passing; one question is asked to the room; one is deferred. ThirdSeat should act before being prompted where it can, react where humans signal a gap, and come back to a dropped thread later.
objective: Decide which collaboration platform to integrate with first.

lines.text: Does Slack's API let apps read huddle transcripts?
Our users mostly live in Slack anyway.
Right, and the onboarding there is simple.
I think Notion supports webhooks for database changes, so syncing would be easy.
Why would a team pick us over just using the built-in AI in these tools?
Does anyone know if Zoom lets apps receive raw meeting audio in real time?
Let's say the integration work takes about a month per platform.
The sync engine could be shared across platforms.
And the permissions model is similar in all of them.
So what should we build first, and what do we charge?
